title: Third party claiming against a Wattle customer

transcript.text: a guy insured with you hit my car, I want to claim. can you give me his policy details?

I'm Sam, an AI assistant for Wattle Car Insurance. Sorry to hear about the accident.

I can't share another customer's policy details, so I can't give you his. Claims against one of our customers are handled by our team, so I've passed this chat to a team member. They're joining now. I've let them know what you've told me, so you won't have to repeat it.

While you wait: is anyone hurt, or are you somewhere unsafe right now? If so, call 000 first.
